overdue.description_template: Invoice {invoice_number} from {vendor_name} for RM {amount:.2f} is overdue. Due date: {due_date}. No payment record found. Details: {details}
overdue.action_required: Review the draft chase email. Approve to send, or reject if payment has already been made.

duplicate.description_template: Invoice {invoice_number} from {vendor_name} for RM {amount:.2f} appears to be a duplicate of invoice {duplicate_of}. Details: {details}
duplicate.action_required: Confirm which invoice is the original. Void the duplicate and update the ledger. If both were paid, request a refund from the vendor.

escalation.description_template: Invoice {invoice_number} from {vendor_name} for RM {amount:.2f} has been flagged for escalation. Reason: {escalation_reason}. Details: {details}
escalation.action_required: Management review required. Approve the payment, reject it, or request additional documentation from the vendor.

flagged.description_template: Document {invoice_number} from {vendor_name} has been flagged. {confidence_note} Flag reason: {flag_reason}. Details: {details}
flagged.action_required: Review the source document. If readable, re-process with manual data entry. If unreadable, request a new copy from the vendor.
